page.title: Account
page.description: Company accounts: balances, the ledger and reconciliation.

overview.totalDescription: Sum of the USD balances of the active accounts.

empty.title: No accounts yet
empty.description: Create the first company account to see its balances.

empty.title: No accounts
empty.description: Create an account to get started.

table.search: Search by name, institution or holder

form.description: The account details. The identifier is stored masked.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: Name, type and how the account is identified.

opening.title: Opening balance
opening.description: The balance the account starts with in the ledger.

fields.name: Name
fields.currencyHint: The currency cannot change once the account has movements.
fields.currencyLockedHint: Locked: the account already has movements.
fields.identifierHint: Only the last 4 digits or the ends of the address are stored. Empty: the current one is kept.
fields.activeHint: An inactive account takes no new payments or transfers.

detail.balanceDescription: Balance in the account currency, as of today.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.description: Every movement that changes the balance, with the running balance after it.

empty.title: No movements
empty.description: Payments, expenses, transfers and movements will appear here.

reconcile.title: Reconciliation
reconcile.description: Compares the statement balance with the system balance. A difference suggests an adjustment.
reconcile.readOnly: Read only: you do not have permission to reconcile this account.
reconcile.suggestion: The difference suggests an adjustment for that amount.
reconcile.noDifference: No difference: the system balance matches the statement.

transfer.title: New transfer
transfer.description: Moves money between two company accounts. The origin is debited with the fee; the destination receives what arrives, in its currency.

route.title: Route
route.description: Which account the money leaves and which one it reaches.

amounts.title: Amounts
amounts.description: What leaves the origin and what arrives at the destination.

fields.rateHint: Only when the currencies differ: amount arriving divided by amount leaving.
fields.usdRatePending: Choose the origin account to load the rate.

movement.title: New movement
movement.description: A partner contribution or withdrawal, or a signed adjustment to balance the account.

movement.title: Movement
movement.description: Type, account, amount and, when it applies, the partner.

fields.typeHint: Contributions and withdrawals take a positive amount.
fields.adjustmentHint: An adjustment carries a sign: a negative one lowers the balance.
fields.amountSignedHint: It can be negative, but not zero.
fields.usdRatePending: Choose the account to load the rate.

validation.sameAccount: The origin and destination accounts must be different
validation.currencyLocked: The currency cannot change once the account has movements
